title: chore: correct community app metadata
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
## Summary

- Corrects metadata for 6 community catalog rows.
- Does not remove apps or add screenshots.

| App | Field | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Pollinations AI  Claude Code CLI Plugin | url | https://www.ai-ministries.com/downloads/ | https://github.com/Tolerable/pollinations-claude-code |
| Lytura AI | name | Pollination Gallery AI | Lytura AI |
| StellarMind | name | medi translate | StellarMind |
| Blossom-ai (Python SDK) | url | https://pypistats.org/packages/eclips-blossom-ai | https://pypi.org/project/eclips-blossom-ai/ |
| NailsGen | emoji | 🖼️ | 💅 |
| NailsGen | name | imggen.top | NailsGen |
| NailsGen | url | https://www.imggen.top/ | https://www.nailsgen.com/ |
| NailsGen | description | Free, no-login AI image generator with unlimited FLUX creations. | Generate custom AI nail art designs in any style and color. |
| LobeHub | name | LobeChat | LobeHub |
| LobeHub | url | https://lobechat.com | https://lobehub.com/ |
| LobeHub | description | Open-source AI chat framework with multi-model support, plugins, and customizable agent workflows | Organize and operate AI agents across long-running tasks, integrations, and multimodal workflows. |
| LobeHub | repositoryUrl | https://github.com/lobehub/lobe-chat | https://github.com/lobehub/lobehub |

gist.headline: The catalog got name tags
gist.blurb: Six community apps received their proper names, links, and descriptions. The garden labels now point to the plants they actually describe.
gist.summary: Corrected names, URLs, descriptions, repository links, and the emoji for six community catalog entries: Pollinations AI Claude Code CLI Plugin, Lytura AI, StellarMind, Blossom-ai, NailsGen, and LobeHub.
gist.impact: Visitors can now find the correct projects directly from the community catalog, including the updated NailsGen nail-art listing and LobeHub repository link.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy community-app garden with six clearly labeled flower pots replacing mismatched labels; Polli acts as a careful catalog keeper, updating name tags and signposts while a friendly CRT robot checks that each link leads to the right little project booth.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute bee mascot with a yellow body, dark brown stripes, black oval eyes, pink rectangular blush, light blue wings, and a tiny librarian visor, carefully replacing labels on six flowering code-plants in a warm community app garden while a chunky CRT monitor robot checks matching signposts. Prominent lime green (#ecf874) garden accents and terminal glow, soft mint, lavender, peach, and warm cream gradients, subtle pixel-font text reading “CATALOG”, cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
